title: 上游错误分类、超时与有限重试（夹具）
aiLayer: FIXTURE_AI —— 确定性本地夹具与故障注入，非远程推理。禁止表述为「AI 已通过」。
sourceRun: evidence/dev/STEP-4/T4-all/（单次运行，按任务卡切片）

assertions.title: FIXTURE_AI: 401/403 become ai_auth_failed with exactly one model call
FIXTURE_AI: 429 becomes ai_quota_exceeded with exactly one model call
FIXTURE_AI: 5xx and unknown upstream failures become ai_upstream_unavailable, one call
FIXTURE_AI: an untrusted error code is never echoed back as the reason
FIXTURE_AI: a malformed result is repaired at most once, so at most two model calls
FIXTURE_AI: a successful repair on the second call is accepted
FIXTURE_AI: a timeout raises ai_timeout and never issues another model call
FIXTURE_AI: a missing or non-callable AI binding fails before any inference
FIXTURE_AI: every one of the five durations reaches the model with its pinned max_tokens
